title: farmoytit fanak sahlik yan rooci
intro: Qadli fan seeco xongolo Qur'aanak ayatitteh addat tantabbe. Tama barkat le rooci, Israa’iil xayloh fanat miraaciino kaxxam faxxiimak sugte waktih addat, nabiyyi kee diini kutbeh buxah addal geytimta. Tama num saanih sinni ummattat yaabeeh, sinni Rabbih kassitih ken kassiise. sabri kee kibal, oson ifi iffonta yekken aydaadi diini kutbeh galitte ifisa. Atu ta assakat le num baxissam duuddaa kay migaq Qur'aan kee Injil inkih yassakaxxeenim?
clues: Anu inni ummattah fayxih uddur nabiinuu kee qaran kitaabak konnabna luk suge.
Yiina yoo toobokem assakat le gurral, dubuk Yallih amri.
Anu inni ummattah yaabiseh, 'O Israa-eel xaylo! Anu Yallih farmoyta kinniyo, yok naharal temeetem diggoysa.'
Anu ku Rabbik qado astooti luk emeeteeh, nabiyyih migaq Acmad yakke farmo xaagu baahe.
Yiina qunxa mariinok xabba haanam Yallih affaafayal yoo teceeh tan barrak sugte.
Yalli qhuraan yoo barseeh, yiinah racmatta kee dirki yoo abeeh, anu kaxxiinaa kee numma num makkinna.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Nabi Macammad صلى الله عليه وسلم

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
